name: io.github.iowarp/spack-mcp
title: CLIO Spack
description: Structured Spack discovery and installation tools for scientific agents

tools.name: spack_find
tools.description: List installed Spack packages matching an optional constraint.

tools.name: spack_locate
tools.description: Resolve one unique installed Spack spec and return its exact prefix.

tools.name: spack_install
tools.description: Install one Spack spec with explicit reusable or fresh concretization and verify that a matching install is observable.

resources.name: spack_capabilities
resources.description: Describe the stateless Spack contract exposed by this server.

prompts.name: prepare_spack_package
prompts.description: Guide an agent through deterministic package preparation.
